functionality.rationale: A scanner defect could either admit architecture erosion or block all future feature work with false positives.

security.rationale: Dependency direction keeps hostile input and FFI access inside native validation boundaries.

performance.rationale: The scanner runs on every verification and must finish with bounded repository-local file traversal.

compatibility.rationale: The initial allow-list must preserve all current legal imports, includes, and CMake target links.

concurrency.rationale: The scanner is a synchronous read-only process and adds no shared runtime state.

platform.rationale: Path normalization and source discovery must behave consistently on macOS, Linux, and Windows CI.

persistence.rationale: The gate reads tracked source and creates no product or governance persisted format.

adr.rationale: The task enforces already accepted internal dependency direction without changing a public contract.

architecture.rationale: The durable architecture is unchanged; AGENTS.md records the new enforcement command.

roadmap.rationale: A dependency gate improves engineering quality but does not complete a product milestone.
